title: Annual Salaries & Wages by State & Sex
description: Number of recipients, median and mean monthly salaries & wages of employees who are Malaysian citizens by state and sex.
methodology:
This data is produced from the Salaries & Wages Survey (SWS), which DOSM conducts alongside the Labour Force Survey (LFS) through personal interviews with households in private living quarters, covering urban and rural areas in all states.

**Salaries & wages** refer to the monthly wage rate received by employees in the public and private sectors from their principal job in the reference month, comprising:
- basic wages
- cost-of-living allowances
- other guaranteed and regularly paid allowances in cash or in kind
- overtime payments

They exclude bonuses, gratuities, family allowances and social security payments made by employers. The statistics cover employees aged 15-64; employers, own-account workers, unpaid family workers, domestic workers employed by households and casual workers are not covered.
